versions.subject: rule: ProxyShell patterns
versions.detection:
selection1:
    c-uri|contains|all:
        - '/autodiscover/autodiscover.json?'
        - '%3f@'
selection2:
    c-uri|contains: 
        # since we don't know how it will appear in the log files, we'll just use all versions
        - 'autodiscover.json?@'
        - 'autodiscover.json%3f@'
        - '%3f@foo.com'
        - 'Email=autodiscover/autodiscover.json'
        - 'json?@foo.com'
        - 'autodiscover.json?@'
condition: 1 of them
